summary: Stores everyone shops at: Walmart, Amazon, Costco, Home Depot, Kroger, CVS and Walgreens are gimmes, Lidl finds the Schwarz Group, and Target at #11 is the trap.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. A US casual found 8 (Walmart, Amazon, Costco, Home Depot, Kroger, CVS, Walgreens, Aldi) and lost lives on Target (#11), Lowe's (#14), Best Buy, IKEA and 7-Eleven, each with its revenue; a European player finds fewer (Tesco #15, Carrefour #13).

Groups are found by their stores: lidl and kaufland are the Schwarz Group, walgreens and boots its holding company, zara Inditex, uniqlo Fast Retailing. Whole Foods, Sam's Club, Trader Joe's, eBay and Temu are free.
100 ranked retailers: a casual Blitz scored 25 of 34 names.
fixes: Deloitte's figures are for fiscal 2023, the latest on the page; update when the page moves to the next Global Powers of Retailing.
'store' and 'supermarket' offer Ross Stores and Morrisons as a misspelling (a confirm, not a life): category words for the matcher if players stumble on it.
